messages:
Nia Kapoor: Following up from the all-hands Q&A 1 capturing the customer wins/losses patterns and asks for leadership. Short thread so we can get decisions quickly.

Owen Price: Field summary: wins = burst stability + transparent cost metrics; losses = BYO-KMS in VPC and lack of a small on-prem reference for procurement.

Lina Morales: CS datapoint: several deals specifically asked for audit-log export to their SIEM during procurement. One RFP said they'd pick a vendor who could demo it within 10 business days.

Raj Singh: Engineering note: streaming tail p99 under long sessions was also flagged in two accounts. Ops is assembling a repro.

Owen Price: Top asks from sales/CS: 1) BYO-KMS in VPC + audit export, 2) tiny on-prem reference bundle, 3) eval-gate in Console to block bad rollouts, 4) recommended canary config + streaming best-practices.

Nia Kapoor: Leadership Q: which items do Execs want prioritized for Q1? My recommended order: KMS/audit (Q1), eval-gate prototype (Q1), on-prem reference (early Q2).

infra-bot: Infra summary: INF-1001 (KMS proxy auth), INF-1007 (audit-export reliability), INF-1013 (VPC onboarding automation). Status: triaged; ETA ~4-6w if prioritized.

Lina Morales: Sales request: a one-page "support today vs roadmap" doc to hand to procurement. Need it by next Tue. Also want 1-2 anonymized customer quotes.

Raj Singh: Action items: 1) Eng/Infra confirm blockers + ETA by Thu EOD, 2) PM/docs draft one-pager by Tue, 3) Ops upload streaming repro + traces, 4) DevEx publish canary + prefix-caching examples this sprint.

Owen Price: Quick wins list for next 2 weeks: publish canary example, add SDK prefix-caching snippet, and a short FAQ on KMS status.

Nia Kapoor: Thanks 1 please confirm headcount/budget decisions for reassigning 1-2 infra engineers to INF-1001/1007 so we can promise dates to customers. I'll post a short summary + tracker in #product after infra replies.

Lina Morales: Quote to include (anonymized): "We signed with the vendor that could export audit logs into our SIEM during procurement."

Owen Price: :thumbsup: End of thread for now 1 will follow up in #sales-docs when one-pager is ready.
